eyebrow: NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases · Chapter Twelve
subtitle: Lesson 69 · Graph Algorithms & Data Science

code:
CALL gds.nodeSimilarity.stream(
  'customerProductGraph')
YIELD node1, node2, similarity
RETURN gds.util.asNode(node1).name AS c1,
       gds.util.asNode(node2).name AS c2,
       similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC
caption: Shared connections / union of connections. 1.0 = identical.

eyebrow: Bought X also bought Y — plain Cypher
code:
MATCH (target:Customer {name:'Priya Nair'})
  -[:PURCHASED]->(:Product)
  <-[:PURCHASED]-(other:Customer)
  -[:PURCHASED]->(rec:Product)
WHERE NOT (target)-[:PURCHASED]->(rec)
RETURN rec.name, count(*) AS strength
ORDER BY strength DESC
caption: A two-hop traversal — no GDS required at all.
